selection: Choose lowest median design-weighted outer-fold log loss across all five fixed company partitions, then median Brier and name. No best-seed selection. Nested regularization is selected using only companies outside the scored outer fold. Final model is a research candidate only.
limits: All 303 companies have been reused for development; nested calibration does not undo previous base-model selection exposure and is not fresh final validation. Population weights and release floors stay unchanged.
